LanguageData.LiASS_ConfirmMedicine: Deliver {0} medicine units to {1}? They will be consumed and removed from caravan inventory.

LanguageData.LiASS_MigrateDescription: Permanently settle an adult free colonist or colony slave in {0}. Free colonists add up to 10 strength; slaves add 5.
LanguageData.LiASS_Confirm:
Send {0} to settle permanently in {1}?

Strength gain: +{2}. This person joins the receiving faction and cannot be recalled through this feature. Their identity and relationships are preserved. Worn apparel and equipped weapons go with them; inventory stays with the caravan. Carrying capacity decreases when a member leaves; check the remaining cargo before returning.

The same person cannot provide migration strength again, even if recruited back. At least one capable adult colonist must remain to lead the caravan.
LanguageData.LiASS_Unavailable: Requires a nearby allied settlement at the caravan's current tile, with no active settlement map.
LanguageData.LiASS_NoCapacity: The settlement is collapsed or already at maximum strength.
LanguageData.LiASS_Ineligible: Requires an adult free colonist or your colony's slave who is neither downed nor in a mental break. Prisoners cannot migrate.
LanguageData.LiASS_Temporary: Temporary, borrowed or quest-reserved colonists cannot migrate.
LanguageData.LiASS_AlreadyMigrated: This person has already provided a permanent migration contribution.
LanguageData.LiASS_LastLeader: At least one other capable adult free colonist must remain to lead the caravan.
LanguageData.LiASS_InventoryFailed: Inventory could not be fully transferred. Migration cancelled; the colonist and items remain in the caravan.
LanguageData.LiASS_TransferFailed: Migration failed. No strength was awarded. See the log for details.
LanguageData.LiASS_Disabled: The allied settlement survival system is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.LiASS_CollapseLetterText: {0} has lost all settlement strength. Its active aid or threat quests have ended. The settlement will be replaced by a destroyed-settlement marker when no map or active quest still refers to it.
LanguageData.LiASS_CollapseLetterTextRetained: {0} has lost all settlement strength. Its active aid or threat quests have ended. Automatic removal is disabled, so the settlement will remain on the world map.
LanguageData.LiASS_Setting_EnabledTip: When disabled, strength recovery and crisis timers pause. Settlement and caravan commands are hidden.
LanguageData.LiASS_Setting_RemoveAtZeroTip: Collapsed settlements remain pending when disabled. Removal waits until their map and active quests no longer reference them.
LanguageData.LiASS_OverviewUnavailable: The settlement survival component is not available.
LanguageData.LiASS_OverviewEmpty: No allied settlements are currently registered.
